settings.title: Settings
settings.themeLoadFailed: Failed to load server config; theme unavailable
settings.providersEmpty: No providers yet. Click Add above to create one.
settings.providerNameRule: Name must start with a letter or digit; may contain letters, digits, dot, underscore and hyphen
settings.providerAdded: Added. Fill it in, then click Save All.
settings.configUnavailable: Cannot read server config. Ensure the daemon is running and the token is valid.
settings.requestOverrideHint: Headers and body are both JSON objects; header values must be strings. Keys are deep-merged into the built-in request, overriding duplicates.
settings.requestHeadersInvalid: The request headers of {name} are not a valid JSON object (values must be strings)
settings.requestBodyInvalid: The request body of {name} is not a valid JSON object
settings.connBaseUrlDesc: Leave empty to use the address this page was opened from.
settings.connTokenDesc: Must match server.token in the daemon settings.json.
settings.connTokenRequired: Enter the access token first (server.token in the daemon settings.json)
settings.connNameDesc: Used to tell connections apart and switch between them.
settings.connEmpty: No saved connections yet. Fill in the fields below and click Save & Connect.
settings.connLocalOnly: This page is not served by oma web; the connection is kept in this browser only.
settings.connUnauthorized: Token rejected (401). Check server.token in settings.json.
settings.connUnreachable: Cannot reach {base}. Check the address and that the daemon is running.
settings.themeDesc: Light and dark each reference a palette; the accent overlays it.
settings.skillNoWorkspace: Open a session to manage project skills for its workspace.
settings.skillsEmpty: No skills yet. Click Add to create one.
settings.skillReadonly: Built-in skills are read-only; save as a new skill instead.
settings.manageThemesDesc: Palettes live as JSON files under the config themes directory.
settings.paletteBaseHint: Switching the base copies all 26 tokens as the starting point.
settings.paletteIdExists: A palette with id {id} already exists
settings.skillsHint: Skills are discovered across three layers: global ~/.agents/skills, agent ~/.config/oma/skills, project <workspace>/.agents/skills; project > agent > global on name clashes. Switch layer with the tabs above; only a catalog is injected and the model reads the body when relevant.
settings.skillToolsHint: Leave empty to allow every tool the agent has.
settings.reasoningMapHint: Map each level to a vendor-specific string; leave blank to send the level name as-is.
settings.defaultReasoningDesc: Initial reasoning level for new sessions; adjustable in the chat.
